description_ko: 두꺼운 두 다리로 버티는 중장갑 정원 수호자. 커진 두 팔이 하나의 거대 전지가위를 잡고, 꽃 유리함을 펼쳐진 꽃받침 갑주가 보호한다.

references.role: Primary Flora Gear identity, materials and gardening motifs; not slender body anatomy or pose lock
Opened calyx armor, winding drum and curled teal mechanical springs; not anatomy lock

visual_qa.identity: Dark teal gardener cap, carved ivory short curls, angular porcelain doll face, intact brass-capped glass chest chamber with exactly one blue flower and green stem, teal apron-like leaf panels and ivory/brass materials retained.
visual_qa.hard_transformation: Massive upright broad-shouldered biped with exactly two planted feet and thick armored legs; two enlarged upper arms and hands operate one shared-pivot pair of giant pruning shears. No quadruped torso, extra legs, knuckle-walking stance, insect anatomy or tail.
visual_qa.mechanics: Both hands grip separate handle loops of one connected scissors mechanism. Two blades and one brass center pivot remain readable. One brass back drum supports two teal curled spring strips. Four opened calyx armor plates frame the glass flower core.
visual_qa.anatomy_and_frame: One head, two arms/hands, two legs, two planted feet, one blue flower, one connected scissors with two blades. All cap, spring, foot and blade tips are inside frame. Upper spring has a narrow but uncut margin.
